correctness.rationale: For the smooth F3 model y³−y=x²/(x³+2x²+1), denominator is irreducible cubic, yielding 3 simple geometric poles, genus four via Artin–Schreier Riemann–Hurwitz and 3-rank four by Deuring–Shafarevich. Correctly count three rational points over infinity and one per rational pole; independent exhaustive finite-field arithmetic at F_{3^n}, n=1..4 reproduces N_n=(6,12,42,132). Newton identities and genus-four Weil functional equation uniquely give L_X=1+2T+3T²+8T³+25T⁴+24T⁵+27T⁶+54T⁷+81T⁸=(1+T+T²+3T³+9T⁴)². The genus-two curve v²=u⁵+u⁴+u²+1 is smooth by the explicit polynomial Bézout identity; independent counts (5,11) over F3,F9 plus genus-two functional equation determine L_C=1+T+T²+3T³+9T⁴. Tate's isogeny theorem gives unpolarized J(X)∼J(C)² over F3. Frobenius quartic t⁴+t³+t²+3t+9 modulo 2 is Φ5 irreducible, showing F3 simplicity; middle coefficient prime to 3 gives ordinarity. #JX(F3)=L_X(1)=225. No explicit isogeny morphism/polarization claimed.
